pubcol-w-82b71621b237457b.definition_en: to affect the way someone or something develops, behaves, or thinks
pubcol-w-82b71621b237457b.example_simple: Her teacher had an influence on her choice of career.
pubcol-w-82b71621b237457b.example_complex: The economic crisis has had a profound influence on how young people view job security.

pubcol-w-32dc178ddf1e13d2.definition_en: to undergo surgery, or for a surgeon to perform surgery on someone
pubcol-w-32dc178ddf1e13d2.example_simple: She had an operation on her knee last week.
pubcol-w-32dc178ddf1e13d2.example_complex: The surgeons decided to operate on him immediately to remove the tumour before it spread.

pubcol-w-7114900664d91faf.definition_en: to find something hard to do
pubcol-w-7114900664d91faf.example_simple: I had difficulty finding the address in the dark.
pubcol-w-7114900664d91faf.example_complex: Many students have difficulty adjusting to the workload during their first year at university.
pubcol-w-7114900664d91faf.vi_meaning_correction: gặp khó khăn trong việc gì

pubcol-w-4e69d3eba7f1462d.definition_en: to have the power to affect a person's decisions or behaviour
pubcol-w-4e69d3eba7f1462d.example_simple: His older brother has a lot of influence over him.
pubcol-w-4e69d3eba7f1462d.example_complex: Lobby groups continue to have considerable influence over the government's environmental agenda.
pubcol-w-4e69d3eba7f1462d.vi_meaning_correction: có ảnh hưởng, tác động lên ai

pubcol-w-36654d3c838fc856.definition_en: to spend money in a foolish or wasteful way despite being wealthy
collocations: clearly have more money than sense
have more money than sense to spend
spend as if having more money than sense
pubcol-w-36654d3c838fc856.example_simple: He bought three sports cars in one year — he has more money than sense.
pubcol-w-36654d3c838fc856.example_complex: Anyone who pays that much for a bottle of water clearly has more money than sense.
pubcol-w-36654d3c838fc856.vi_meaning_correction: lắm tiền nhưng tiêu xài phung phí, thiếu khôn ngoan

a7d738eb-4a8f-44e2-989e-fc387b64bd93.definition_en: to not yet have had any dealings or contact with someone or something

pubcol-w-dd51ab481deb9a95.definition_en: to possess or make use of something
pubcol-w-dd51ab481deb9a95.example_simple: You must have or use a valid ticket to enter.
pubcol-w-dd51ab481deb9a95.example_complex: The policy sets out who may have or use confidential data within the organisation.
pubcol-w-dd51ab481deb9a95.vi_meaning_correction: có hoặc sử dụng cái gì

pubcol-w-47b7d7ac7f96ba11.definition_en: to share the same interests, features, or characteristics with someone or something
pubcol-w-47b7d7ac7f96ba11.example_simple: We have a lot in common — we both love hiking and old films.
pubcol-w-47b7d7ac7f96ba11.example_complex: Despite their different backgrounds, the two writers had a great deal in common in their views on society.

pubcol-w-85f818b3bf2e190a.definition_en: (informal) to feel a strong sexual attraction to someone
collocations: have the hots for a colleague
have the hots for the new guy
pubcol-w-85f818b3bf2e190a.example_simple: It's obvious she has the hots for the new intern.
pubcol-w-85f818b3bf2e190a.example_complex: He tried to act casual, but everyone could tell he had the hots for his flatmate.

pubcol-w-8a72cccbe98f12f8.definition_en: to be in front of others in a competition or to move into first position
collocations: take the lead in the second half
pubcol-w-8a72cccbe98f12f8.example_simple: Our team took the lead in the final minute of the match.
pubcol-w-8a72cccbe98f12f8.example_complex: After trailing for most of the race, she surged forward to take the lead on the final lap.
pubcol-w-8a72cccbe98f12f8.vi_meaning_correction: dẫn đầu; vượt lên để dẫn đầu

pubcol-w-e8eb5650624f944f.definition_en: to be out of touch with reality; to be daydreaming or impractical
collocations: always have your head in the clouds
walk around with your head in the clouds
have your head in the clouds again
pubcol-w-e8eb5650624f944f.example_simple: Stop dreaming and pay attention — you've got your head in the clouds.
pubcol-w-e8eb5650624f944f.example_complex: As a planner she was brilliant, but when it came to budgets she tended to have her head in the clouds.

pubcol-w-9802bcaecef5d4e8.definition_en: to remember or take something into consideration
pubcol-w-9802bcaecef5d4e8.example_simple: Keep in mind that the shops close early on Sundays.
pubcol-w-9802bcaecef5d4e8.example_complex: When designing the survey, researchers must bear in mind the cultural background of the respondents.

pubcol-w-df9d11eb13d772da.definition_en: to be very successful in doing something
pubcol-w-df9d11eb13d772da.example_simple: The band achieved huge success with their first album.
pubcol-w-df9d11eb13d772da.example_complex: The company enjoyed great success in expanding into overseas markets during the past decade.

pubcol-w-f82a06e23b0ee1d5.definition_en: to lead to a successful or noticeable outcome
pubcol-w-f82a06e23b0ee1d5.example_simple: The new training method is already producing results.
pubcol-w-f82a06e23b0ee1d5.example_complex: The reforms took years to implement, but they eventually produced measurable results across the whole sector.

pubcol-w-3c95174e581a11ff.definition_en: to stop working or an activity for a short period to rest
pubcol-w-3c95174e581a11ff.example_simple: Let's take a break and have some coffee.
pubcol-w-3c95174e581a11ff.example_complex: After working non-stop for six hours, the team finally took a break to recharge.

pubcol-w-a70f81de13602207.definition_en: to feel strongly inclined to do something (often something bold or critical)
collocations: have a good mind to complain
have a great mind to leave
pubcol-w-a70f81de13602207.example_simple: I have a good mind to tell him exactly what I think.
pubcol-w-a70f81de13602207.example_complex: After being kept waiting for an hour, she had a great mind to walk out and cancel the whole deal.
pubcol-w-a70f81de13602207.vi_meaning_correction: rất muốn, có ý định (làm gì)

pubcol-w-ca2b941516079cc6.definition_en: to move or travel in the direction of a particular place
pubcol-w-ca2b941516079cc6.example_simple: After work, we headed for the nearest café.
pubcol-w-ca2b941516079cc6.example_complex: As the storm approached, the fishing boats began to head for the safety of the harbour.

pubcol-w-9cd7c186300be567.definition_en: the title of a newspaper article, printed in large letters at the top
pubcol-w-9cd7c186300be567.example_simple: The story made the headlines in every newspaper.
pubcol-w-9cd7c186300be567.example_complex: The scandal dominated the headlines for weeks before the minister finally resigned.

pubcol-w-66fe0da68037a04d.definition_en: the main office or centre from which an organisation is controlled
pubcol-w-66fe0da68037a04d.example_simple: The company's headquarters are in London.
pubcol-w-66fe0da68037a04d.example_complex: The corporation relocated its headquarters to Singapore to be closer to its Asian markets.

pubcol-w-e015b5e9dfbf4828.definition_en: a strong and healthy desire to eat; (figuratively) a keen enthusiasm for something
pubcol-w-e015b5e9dfbf4828.example_simple: The children came home with a healthy appetite after playing outside.
pubcol-w-e015b5e9dfbf4828.example_complex: Even in his eighties, he retained a healthy appetite for new ideas and challenges.

pubcol-w-8357284bcb339ac8.example_simple: There were heaps of leaves in the garden after the storm.
pubcol-w-8357284bcb339ac8.example_complex: She left the interview feeling confident, knowing she had heaps of relevant experience to offer.

pubcol-w-ec1318f3a91bcdf3.definition_en: involving a frank, sincere and personal conversation between two people
pubcol-w-ec1318f3a91bcdf3.example_simple: We had a heart-to-heart talk about her problems at school.
pubcol-w-ec1318f3a91bcdf3.example_complex: It took a long heart-to-heart conversation before the two friends finally cleared up the misunderstanding.

pubcol-w-eb5eeef6ff442323.example_simple: She gave a heartfelt thank-you to everyone who helped.
pubcol-w-eb5eeef6ff442323.example_complex: In his speech, the director offered heartfelt gratitude to the volunteers who had made the project possible.

pubcol-w-d9420082811e9242.example_simple: The region is the agricultural heartland of the country.
